projects.title: Mobile App Development Course Project- Taco Finder
projects.description:
Class project for Mobile App Development course.
Using Android Studio and Google Maps API, we created an application that displays all the taco-selling restaurants near the user, where all the restaurant information is stored on a database.
Currently is not complete, in terms of what we imagine it to be, as it's only limited to our hometown.

projects.title: Equipment Management GUI
projects.description:
Advance Objects class project that was about creating an Equipment Management GUI where an administrator/Coordinator and customer have different features in their respective GUI after they login. An administrator/Coordinator can add/delete/update equipment and equipment locations, read reports and check-in, check-out and reserve equipment. Customers can only check-in, check-out and reserve equipment.
This GUI would connect to a MySQL database using JDBC and I used an xml file to contain the database's information (url, driver, username and password).
